title: Define the vision.
copy: Bring the idea, the audience and the ambition. Together, turn them into a focused product brief.
detail: Tell us who the product is for, what you want it to feel like and where it will be sold. Capture ingredient preferences, target pack size, expected quantity and launch priorities.

title: Find your formula.
copy: Explore textures and ingredient directions. Review samples, share feedback and refine the details.
detail: Evaluate each sample against the brief. Record what works and what needs to change, from the texture during application to the finish after use.

title: Consider every detail.
copy: Align the formula with its packaging and agree on the testing needed before scale-up.
detail: Review the container, closure, dispensing and decoration together. Define stability, compatibility and other required assessments for the product and intended market.
points: PET, HDPE and glass components, dispensing and decoration
Heat, light, humidity, cold and freeze/thaw exposure planning
Interactions between actives, preservatives, fragrance and pack materials
Specifications, documentation and specialist laboratory responsibilities

title: Bring it to life.
copy: Coordinate the approved formula, components and filling requirements for the production run.
detail: Plan the bulk, fill, assembly and pack-out steps. Agree on production checks and finished-goods specifications before scheduling.

title: Prepare for what’s next.
copy: Organize the pack-out and dispatch handoff around your distribution plan.
detail: Confirm final quantities, case packs and shipping requirements. Align the handoff with the needs of your warehouse, retail channel or launch campaign.
points: Case packs, identification and final unit counts
Freight quotations, carrier and distributor documentation
Domestic, international and multi-destination handoff requirements
